feeds.title: green beauty & lifestyle
feeds.description: Lifestyle site showcasing the best green, artisan and organic beauty, mouthwatering food, style and art in London. Anything that inspires wonder and lust!

feeds.title: Natural Beauty with Baby
feeds.description: I'm Helen, 40-something mum to Jonah and Cara, and wife to Martin. I started my blog because I love and want to share natural beauty products. I've had tricky skin in the past with both psoriasis and pregnancy triggered eczema. This led me down the path of searching for skincare to heal my troubled skin. My blog helps me to share the brands and products I find. I really love the beauty and skincare I suggest on my blog, and I hope you'll love it too.

feeds.title: Sara Steele
feeds.description: My name is Sara Steele. I'm a Swedish organic hairstylist. On this page I feature organic and non-animal tested hair products reviews, hair tutorials, hair inspiration ideas and much more!

feeds.title: Glow Organic Blog
feeds.description: Glow Organic is a blog dedicated to the world of green beauty! They discuss organic, natural beauty & provide makeup tutorials using organic products.

feeds.title: Evolve Organic Beauty Blog
feeds.description: Natural beauty and lifestyle news from organic skincare brand Evolve Beauty. Includes handmade beauty recipes, offers, and advice.

feeds.title: Organic Makeup Artist Blog
feeds.description: I am a Make-up Artist and Designer working in film and television. I am passionate about organic cosmetics and want to show that there are viable, ethical alternatives to mainstream products.

feeds.title: soapNskin
feeds.description: soapNskin is an multi award winning natural British skincare brand. Their monthly blog is written by its co-founders Samar Fazil and Rabia Khan and covers a wide range of topics. Discover natural DIY recipe hacks to ingredient myth busters and natural well-being advice. Tacking a multitude of topics from addressing skin conditions using natural ingredients to ways to enhance mental and physical wellbeing. With a focus on natural, ethical beauty which has been inspired by the founders' dual heritage. Expect to uncover age old beauty rituals from the Silk Roads...
